stories.headline: Child attacked, dragged by coyote at Edwards Gardens: Toronto police
stories.summary: Toronto Police have issued a public safety alert after a child was attacked by a coyote in a park in the area of Lawrence Avenue East and The Bridle Path on Thursday. The attack took place just after 11:30 a.m. in Edward Gardens.
